sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P2, 
 والتي يجب إجراؤها كل ستة أشهر كما هو موضح بواسطة M6 في مقطع العنوان

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Ahmed Fawzy Badry, tested by eng. Nabeel saad Ibrahem 
 at 01 July 2003, accepted by general director 
 eng. Shawqy Mahmoud Attala, and approved by eng. Mohamed Mahdey Rezq 
 Alnshar Head Sector of Sidi Kirir 1&2 Power Station.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة،

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear safety helmet, and safety shoes.

The 
 breaker of the motor must be isolated

ال 
 يجب تفريغ ملفات المحرك والمكثفات باستخدام سلك صلب أولاً 
 قبل لمس اللفات

The 
 motor is stopped and electrically isolated before check

أدوات 
والمعدات
Electrical equipment kit, megger 5000V.
Dry cloth, dry air from air blower or surface line
New filters if necessary

items: Dry cloth, dry air from air blower or surface line

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Carryout the MPIS document No. M-002-r0 every two months
Clean the inside of the motor using dry air

Open the junction box and check the cable terminals tightening, tighten any 
 loose bolt if any
Clean the junction box and capacitors surfaces.
Measure the winding insulation using megger 5000v
